intro: CAVA Sweet Tea (16 oz) offers a refreshing Southern-style beverage made with brewed black tea and cane sugar. At 150 calories, this classic drink provides a sweet complement to any meal from the [full CAVA menu](/). Perfect for those seeking a traditional tea experience with Mediterranean-inspired dishes.
priceCalories: Priced at $3.45 for a 16 oz serving, CAVA Sweet Tea contains 150 calories with 37g of carbohydrates and zero fat or protein. This beverage offers excellent value as part of the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks), providing a moderately sweet refreshment option that balances flavor with caloric content.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA Sweet Tea apart is its simple, authentic preparation using only brewed black tea and cane sugar. Unlike artificial alternatives, this drink features real ingredients without preservatives or artificial sweeteners. The classic Southern recipe pairs exceptionally well with Mediterranean flavors from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls).
nutritionFacts: Each 16 oz serving of CAVA Sweet Tea delivers 150 calories entirely from 37g of carbohydrates. With 0g of protein and 0g of fat, this beverage provides quick energy through natural cane sugar. For detailed nutritional planning, visit the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to track your meal totals.
whatsInside: CAVA Sweet Tea contains just two pure ingredients: brewed black tea and cane sugar. The black tea is carefully brewed to extract rich flavor and natural antioxidants, while cane sugar adds authentic Southern sweetness. This simple ingredient list makes it suitable for various dietary preferences on the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu).
tasteLike: CAVA Sweet Tea delivers a classic Southern sweet tea experience with robust black tea flavor balanced by smooth cane sugar sweetness. The taste is refreshingly crisp without being overly syrupy, offering genuine tea notes that shine through the sweetness. It provides a clean, satisfying finish that cleanses the palate between bites.
customize: While CAVA Sweet Tea comes perfectly balanced as prepared, you can customize your beverage experience by requesting light ice for more tea or extra ice for maximum chill. Consider ordering the 22 oz size for larger meals or pairing it with other drinks from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) for variety.
pairsWell: CAVA Sweet Tea pairs excellently with spicy dishes from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains), as the sweetness balances heat beautifully. It complements grilled proteins, Mediterranean spices, and rich dips from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads). The tea also works wonderfully alongside lighter salads and grain bowls.
healthyChoice: At 150 calories per 16 oz serving, CAVA Sweet Tea offers a moderate beverage choice with natural ingredients. While it contains 37g of sugar, it uses real cane sugar rather than high-fructose corn syrup or artificial sweeteners. Those monitoring sugar intake may prefer unsweetened alternatives or smaller portions.
howToOrder: Order CAVA Sweet Tea by selecting it from the drinks section when building your meal at any [CAVA Locations](/locations). Choose the 16 oz size for $3.45 or upgrade to 22 oz for additional refreshment. Add it to your order online, through the app, or in-store for dine-in or takeout service.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade (16 oz) at 260 calories, CAVA Sweet Tea offers a lighter 150-calorie option while maintaining sweetness and flavor. Blueberry Lavender (16 oz) provides similar calories at 140 but with floral notes. Sweet Tea delivers traditional Southern taste for those preferring classic tea over fruit-forward beverages.
whoShouldTry: CAVA Sweet Tea is perfect for sweet tea enthusiasts, Southern food lovers, and anyone seeking a classic beverage to complement Mediterranean cuisine. Those who enjoy traditional iced tea with sweetness will appreciate this authentic preparation. It suits customers wanting a familiar drink alongside adventurous menu choices from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas).
worthTrying: CAVA Sweet Tea is absolutely worth trying for its authentic preparation and perfect balance of tea and sweetness. At $3.45 for 16 oz, it offers excellent value with quality ingredients and classic flavor. The simple recipe using brewed black tea and cane sugar delivers genuine Southern taste.
